content_blocks.label: clause_1._CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: RECEIVING PARTY acknowledges that it has received CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_USE_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: RECEIVING PARTY agrees to use CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION solely for the purposes set forth in this agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.2_RESTRICTIONS
content_blocks.text: RECEIVING PARTY shall not disclose CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION to any third party without the prior written consent of DISCLOSING PARTY.
